mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as rising demand strengthens equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of GDPC1 increase are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 returns, signaling labor market stress and potential recession.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in UNRATE rises > 0.3pp are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and industrial production index (INDPRO) signal monetary tightening and supply growth, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and INDPRO both rise over the next month
failure_condition: 60-day returns in periods where both FEDFUNDS and INDPRO rise are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a drop in HOUST (demand) predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as market anticipates peak demand and potential correction.
failure_condition: 5-day returns in late-cycle expansion when HOUST drops are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL (inflation) index predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate higher growth and adjust valuations accordingly.
failure_condition: 60-day returns in periods of CPIAUCSL increase are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, sudden spikes trigger negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate recession and tighten credit.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in FEDFUNDS > 4.5% periods are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: Both rising employment (PAYEMS) and demand (RSAFS) simultaneously signal overheating, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as market anticipates inflation and potential correction.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and RSAFS both rise over the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns in periods where both PAYEMS and RSAFS rise are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a drop in FEDFUNDS predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate rate cuts to stabilize the economy.
failure_condition: 5-day returns in monetary tightening when FEDFUNDS drops are not positive.
